PRESCHOOL · AGE 4

Age 4: stories, puzzles and getting ready to read.

Seven big classes for four-year-olds — Shapes, Patterns & Sorting (Class 25), Colors, Mixing & Creativity (Class 26), Early Writing & Pencil Control (Class 27), Phonics & Beginning Sounds (Class 28), Storytime & Pre-Reading (Class 29), Logic, Thinking & Problem-Solving (Class 30) and Science, Nature & Discovery (Class 31) — each with its own shelf of real, playable adventures built on our own artwork.

Age 4Class 25

Shapes, Patterns & Sorting

Nine shapes, three pattern games and the whole Shape Adventures shelf: a spaceship to build, a monster factory, candy sorting and a shape detective.

Open Class 25 ↗
Age 4Class 26

Colors, Mixing & Creativity

Real paint mixing, tap-to-fill coloring you can actually stay inside, movable decorations and a free splatter canvas in the Colors & Creativity studio.

Open Class 26 ↗
Age 4Class 27

Early Writing & Pencil Control

Thirty on-screen tracing adventures in the Writing Adventures library — winding paths, loops, mazes and dot-to-dots with a finger, stylus or mouse.

Open Class 27 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 28

Phonics & Beginning Sounds

Twenty-four listening games with real recorded sound in the Phonics Adventures library — first sounds, rhymes, blending and sound swaps, plus a printable worksheet for every game.

Open Class 28 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 29

Storytime & Pre-Reading Comprehension

Twenty-nine picture-story games with spoken instructions in the Storytime Adventures library — sequencing, clues, feelings and retelling, plus a printable worksheet for every story.

Open Class 29 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 30

Logic, Thinking & Problem-Solving

Thirty picture puzzles with spoken instructions in the Logic Adventures library — patterns, odd ones out, secret codes and one traceable maze, plus a printable worksheet for every puzzle.

Open Class 30 ↗
Ages 4–5Class 31

Science, Nature & Discovery

Thirty discovery games with spoken instructions in the Science Adventures library — plant growth, weather, insects, magnets, habitats, life cycles and a graduation lab, plus a printable worksheet for every experiment.

Open Class 31 ↗

Age ranges are guides, not tests. Start where it is fun, stop while it is fun, and come back whenever you like. Progress saves on this device for the child chosen in My Classroom.
